## Spec

BlockListSpec defines a set of sources compiled into one matcher chain.

Validation: response customIP requires the customIP block (`!has(self.response) || self.response != 'customIP' || has(self.customIP)`)

Validation: RPZ sources require block mode (`!has(self.mode) || self.mode != 'allow' || self.sources.all(s, !has(s.rpz))`)

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `spec.customIP` | `object` | CustomIP is the answer for BlockResponse customIP. |
| `spec.customIP.v4` | `string` |  |
| `spec.customIP.v6` | `string` |  |
| `spec.mode` | `string` | ListMode says whether entries block or allow.<br>Default: `block`<br>One of: `block`, `allow` |
| `spec.refreshInterval` | `string` | Default: `24h` |
| `spec.response` | `string` | BlockResponse is how a blocked query is answered: nxdomain, zeroIP (0.0.0.0 / ::), refused, customIP (the customIP addresses) or blockPage (the addresses of the block page listener, blockPage.ipv4/ipv6, so browsers show why the name is blocked).<br>One of: `nxdomain`, `zeroIP`, `refused`, `customIP`, `blockPage` |
| `spec.sources` | `[]object` | **Required.**<br>Items: 1 to 256 |
| `spec.sources[].configMapRef` | `object` | ObjectRef points at another kudurru object. Namespace is omitted for cluster-scoped kinds and for same-namespace references. |
| `spec.sources[].configMapRef.name` | `string` | **Required.**<br>Length: at least 1 |
| `spec.sources[].configMapRef.namespace` | `string` |  |
| `spec.sources[].enabled` | `boolean` | Enabled false switches this one source off without removing it, like Pi-hole's per-adlist switch: it is not fetched and not compiled, its cached body and status digest are kept, and status.sources\[\] reports it with enabled: false. Omitted means true. The kudurru.io/enabled annotation switches the whole list off. |
| `spec.sources[].entries` | `[]object` | Entries are structured entries (value, type, switch, comment, provenance), as the dashboard's Allowlist and Denylist write them. They compile as adblock rules; format and subdomains do not apply.<br>Items: at most 10000 |
| `spec.sources[].entries[].comment` | `string` | Length: at most 500 |
| `spec.sources[].entries[].created` | `string` | Format: `date-time` |
| `spec.sources[].entries[].createdBy` | `string` | CreatedBy is the actor that added the entry ("user:alice").<br>Length: at most 300 |
| `spec.sources[].entries[].enabled` | `boolean` | Enabled false keeps the entry without applying it. Omitted means true. |
| `spec.sources[].entries[].modified` | `string` | Format: `date-time` |
| `spec.sources[].entries[].origin` | `string` | EntryOrigin records how a structured entry was added.<br>One of: `manual`, `querylog`, `unblock`, `api`, `migrated` |
| `spec.sources[].entries[].request` | `string` | Request is the UnblockRequest ("namespace/name") whose approval added the entry.<br>Length: at most 300 |
| `spec.sources[].entries[].type` | `string` | EntryType is how a structured list entry matches.<br>Default: `exact`<br>One of: `exact`, `wildcard`, `regex` |
| `spec.sources[].entries[].value` | `string` | **Required.** Value is the canonical form for Type: "ads.example.com" (exact), "\*.example.com" (wildcard) or the RE2 expression without slashes (regex).<br>Length: 1 to 1024 |
| `spec.sources[].exclude` | `[]string` | Exclude switches off single entries of this source without editing it, also for URL and ConfigMap sources: each value is a rule as the source's format normalises it ("ads.example.com" for a hosts line "0.0.0.0 ads.example.com", "\|\|ads.example.com^", "/regex/"), as GET /blocklists/{namespace}/{name}/sources/{source}/entries lists them. Excluded rules are not compiled; the exclusions survive refreshes, and values that match nothing in the current body are reported in status.sources\[\].staleExcludes.<br>Items: at most 10000<br>List type: `set` |
| `spec.sources[].format` | `string` | ListFormat is the syntax of a blocklist source.<br>Default: `auto`<br>One of: `auto`, `hosts`, `domains`, `adblock`, `regex`, `rpz` |
| `spec.sources[].inline` | `[]string` |  |
| `spec.sources[].name` | `string` |  |
| `spec.sources[].rpz` | `object` | RPZ transfers a complete policy zone using AXFR/IXFR. Missing or expired enabled data fails closed for policies selecting this required source. |
| `spec.sources[].rpz.primaries` | `[]string` | **Required.** Primaries are ordered transfer endpoints (host or host:port). IPv6 endpoints with a port use brackets. TLS verifies the endpoint hostname.<br>Items: 1 to 32 |
| `spec.sources[].rpz.transferProtocol` | `string` | Default: `tcp`<br>One of: `tcp`, `tls` |
| `spec.sources[].rpz.tsigKeyRef` | `string` | TSIGKeyRef names an operator-managed key, never secret material.<br>Length: at most 253 |
| `spec.sources[].rpz.zoneName` | `string` | **Required.** ZoneName is the non-root absolute policy-zone origin.<br>Pattern: `^([a-zA-Z0-9]([a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?\.)*[a-zA-Z0-9]([a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?\.?$`<br>Length: 1 to 253 |
| `spec.sources[].subdomains` | `boolean` | Subdomains makes the hosts and plain-domain entries of this source match their subdomains too, for lists published as "domains with subdomains". Adblock and wildcard rules are not affected. |
| `spec.sources[].url` | `string` |  |

## Status

BlockListStatus is the observed state of a block list.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `status.conditions` | `[]Condition` | List type: `map`, keyed by `type` |
| `status.entries` | `integer` |  |
| `status.invalid` | `integer` |  |
| `status.lastFetched` | `string` | Format: `date-time` |
| `status.observedGeneration` | `integer` | Format: `int64` |
| `status.ruleCount` | `integer` |  |
| `status.sources` | `[]object` |  |
| `status.sources[].digest` | `string` | Digest is the sha256 of the fetched body; replicas pull by digest from the leader (decision D15). |
| `status.sources[].enabled` | `boolean` | Enabled is false for a source switched off with spec.sources\[\].enabled and absent otherwise. A disabled source keeps the digest, etag, lastFetched and counts of its last fetch and reports no error; status.entries leaves it out. |
| `status.sources[].entries` | `integer` |  |
| `status.sources[].error` | `string` |  |
| `status.sources[].etag` | `string` |  |
| `status.sources[].excluded` | `integer` | Excluded counts the entries of this source that are switched off (spec.sources\[\].exclude hits, or entries with enabled: false); they are not in Entries. |
| `status.sources[].invalid` | `integer` |  |
| `status.sources[].lastFetched` | `string` | Format: `date-time` |
| `status.sources[].name` | `string` | **Required.** |
| `status.sources[].staleExcludes` | `[]string` | StaleExcludes are spec.sources\[\].exclude values that match no rule of the current body (at most 50): the list dropped the entry, or the value is not written the way the source's format normalises it. |
| `status.unsupported` | `integer` | Unsupported counts valid rules this version parses but does not apply, including hosts rewrites and RPZ triggers requiring resolver NS provenance. Supported modifiers are not counted as unsupported. |

## Example

`deploy/kustomize/samples/kudurru.io_v1alpha1_blocklist.yaml`:

```yaml
apiVersion: kudurru.io/v1alpha1
kind: BlockList
metadata:
  name: default-ads
  namespace: dns
spec:
  mode: block
  sources:
    - url: https://big.oisd.nl/
      format: auto
  refreshInterval: 24h
```
